FFmpeg.wasm browser client

This website includes the browser client from @ffmpeg/ffmpeg version 0.12.15.
Project: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm
Package license: MIT

The FFmpeg conversion core is downloaded on demand from jsDelivr and is not
bundled with this website. The core package identifies its license as
GPL-2.0-or-later. Source and license information are available from the project
link above and from https://www.ffmpeg.org/legal.html.
